games.helpBody:
Enable Games for your profile, choose a computer and approve the first connection. Steam can open Big Picture or launch a saved game shortcut inside PlezyNG on receivers that support it. Connect Companion Remote to combine installed games from your computers in one library. Steam pairing does not grant access to a private account library.

Steam receivers are experimental on Android, Linux and Apple. The stream menu provides controller, audio and connection controls. Pyrowave is an optional codec on compatible Android and Apple receivers and needs a fast network.

Pairing requires the host’s approval. Sunshine QR codes open its PIN page without carrying credentials. For access away from home, use the computer’s VPN address. Automatic discovery normally stays on the local network.

Disconnecting leaves the game running on the computer.
